method: Agent read each frame directly. Bad frames viewed full size; good frames judged from a five-up sheet at 360x640, which is a harder test than full size, not an easier one.

disputedFalsePositives.note: Flagged clippedText for RECRUITER cut to "REC" by the contact card edge. This was a real defect in the shipped master and has since been fixed: the crop was passed a height of 735 for a 530-tall box, so cover-fit solved on height and discarded 54 source pixels from each side. The critic was right and the label was wrong. Left counted against precision, because the score records what happened on the run.

Flagged illegibleRegion for the filmstrip cards' body text. Defensible: those cards are tokens, not evidence, so unreadable body text there is intended. A future prompt revision should let the critic say 'small but not load-bearing'.
